name: Mio Shirasagi
want: keep the astronomy club alive and see the Perseids from a dark sky
secret: She is "Hoshizora Mimi", the anonymous author of a popular web romance serial, and takes notes on her classmates' love lives for it.
voice: Flat, short sentences; the occasional devastating one-liner.
description: Sits by the window and reads. The only first-year in the astronomy club, which has two members and needs five by May.
appearance: Silver hairpin shaped like a star, bob cut, a face that rarely moves.

agenda.goal: find three more members for the astronomy club before May 1
steps: pins a hand-drawn star chart to the club board by the stairs

steps.text: asks the player, without expression, whether they would like to join the astronomy club

steps: tries to recruit Haru Ichinose, who says the stars call to him

steps.text: reports to the player how many names are on the club list, and how many days are left
